raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The source has started sending separate status='REVERSAL' rows (24 rows, with orig_txn_id pointing into batches 13–14) instead of only flipping the original to 'REVERSED', so the originals stay 'POSTED' and the pipeline still counts them, inflating recent gold totals. The fix applies the existing REVERSED rule (drop the reversed transaction entirely) to any POSTED transaction referenced by a REVERSAL row; this assumes full reversals, since partial-reversal amounts cannot be checked from the evidence.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.68, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND txn_id NOT IN (SELECT orig_txn_id FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL)"}}
